summary: Frontend test of the 'Gestione Associazione Sportiva' plan-addon card and detail (PlanAddonPanel). On first run the card still showed the old '€99,00/anno · Abbonamento annuale' because GET /api/marketplace/services did not include billing_method, so isAddon() was always false and the PlanAddonPanel never rendered. Fixed with a one-word change to the _public() whitelist in marketplace.py. After the fix every requested check passes on desktop and at 390px mobile. Quote and purchase were checked via curl as context: quote is blocked with purchasable=false, and purchase returns 400.

critical.issue: _public() field whitelist left out billing_method, so the frontend never detected the plan_addon service (wrong price label, no PlanAddonPanel). FIXED by T1 (added 'billing_method' to the whitelist).

ui_bugs.issue: For the plan_addon service the generic footnote still says 'Servizio extra, indipendente dagli abbonamenti BRONZE, SILVER e GOLD: acquistabile con qualsiasi piano, anche gratuito o scaduto', which contradicts the blocking message (paid yearly plan required). Add an isAddon(s) branch with its own text.

issues: mkt-detail-actions sticky bar (-mx-6) causes about 8px horizontal overflow in the dialog. Cosmetic only; content stays readable.

action_items: Review the T1 fix in backend/marketplace.py _public() (billing_method added) and keep it
Change the Detail footnote for isAddon(s) services so it no longer says 'acquistabile con qualsiasi piano, anche gratuito o scaduto'
Optional: fix the 8px horizontal overflow from mkt-detail-actions on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: marketplace.py _public(): new service fields used by the frontend must be added to the whitelist. billing_method was missing.
PlanAddonPanel: when q.blocked is set and the service is not purchasable, only the blocked message shows (plan-addon-not-yet is hidden). This is OK for trial orgs.
PlanAddonPanel is rendered inside the grid, so the blocked message appears before s.terms. Fine.

success_rate.backend: N/A (frontend only; quote/purchase curl checks passed)
success_rate.frontend: 100% after fix (0% before fix: card price/mode and panel missing)

A WelcomeDemo dialog ('Non ora') and a cookie banner ('Reject non-essential') block clicks after login, so dismiss them first. No Stripe purchases were run.
rca of the issue: Marketplace.jsx isAddon(s) checks s.billing_method === 'plan_addon'. The DB doc has it (set by plan_addons.seed), but marketplace._public() builds the response from an explicit field list that did not include billing_method, so the frontend got undefined and used the default price/mode branch and skipped PlanAddonPanel. Mitigation: add billing_method to the whitelist (done).
